title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments

layout.note: Three stacked full-width bands: a row of three screenshots under task instruction 1, a row of three under task instruction 2, and an architecture band with grey boxes at the left, the Agent in the middle and a blue environment region at the right.

lesson: Open with real screen captures of two tasks joined by dashed cursor trails so the reader sees what an agent does, then draw the environment as one blue region holding the logos of the systems, apps and interfaces it covers, with parallel observation and action arrows to a single agent box.
